description: This file is a Java unit test class for SendFeatureMessage, testing its creation, immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and error handling.

classes.name: SendFeatureMessageTest
classes.description: Unit test class for SendFeatureMessage including tests for immutability, equality, construction, JSON serialization/deserialization, and error scenarios.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that SendFeatureMessage instances are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of the equals and hashCode methods of SendFeatureMessage.

methods.name: tryCreateWithNullThingIdString

methods.description: Tests that creating a SendFeatureMessage with null ThingId throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryCreateWithNullFeatureId

methods.description: Tests that creating a SendFeatureMessage with null message throws NullPointerException.
